title: SolarFragments weights
subtitle: Checkpoints and code for Solar Filament Segmentation 2026
description: Inference code (MIT), stage-1 U-Net checkpoints, GBM scorer, rotated-crop refiners and pinned wheels needed to reproduce both final submissions of the SolarFragments entry. Trained only on the competition training labels (no public MAGFiLO labels, no other ground truth). See the reproduction notebook.
